# Loading the Package

```{r setup}
library(Bayou)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse) 
castle <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/refs/heads/main/data/2026/2026-09-01/world_castles.csv")
```

## Data Moves

*Filter*

```{r}
castle %>%
  filter(category == "castle") %>%
  summarise(castle_sum =n())
```

*Group By/Summarise*

```{r}
castle %>%
  filter(category == "castle")%>%
  group_by(century) %>% 
  summarise(cent_sum = n())
```

*Join*

```{r}
totals <- castle %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarise(total = n())

totals <- totals %>%
  mutate(prop = total / 5793)

castle <- castle %>%
  left_join(totals, by = (c="category"))
  
```

*Arrange*

```{r}
castle %>%
  arrange(-desc(fame_rank))
```

*Mutate*

```{r}
castle %>%
  mutate(history = ifelse(castle$century < "500", "Ancient", "Modern"))

```
